## Projects

- [WhatsApp Commerce Copilot](https://sajiddev.systems/projects/whatsapp-commerce-copilot/):
  An AI-powered WhatsApp commerce platform — a React/Vite dashboard, a Python/FastAPI backend, a
  Node.js/Express gateway adapter and a self-hosted Evolution API WhatsApp engine, over PostgreSQL
  and Redis. AI auto-replies answer catalogue questions using only store-scoped products and
  policies retrieved by the backend, with a one-click Human Mode handoff to a person and live stock
  management. Optional LangChain intent chain; the backend keeps working on a deterministic
  catalogue pipeline when no AI key is present, and any product ID the model returns outside the
  retrieved candidate set is rejected. Handles English, Roman Urdu and Urdu script.
  WhatsApp only — there is no Instagram integration in the codebase.
  Built by a four-person squad (Squad Margalla) in Comebck Pakistan Cohort 1, an 8-week AI
  readiness program.
  Tech: Python, FastAPI, React, LangChain, PostgreSQL, Redis, Evolution API, Docker Compose.
  Source: https://github.com/Comebck-Pakistan/cohort-1-squad-margalla/tree/main/whatsapp-commerce-copilot

- [Entropy-Aware Data Preservation System](https://sajiddev.systems/projects/entropy-aware-data-preservation/):
  A PostgreSQL system that tracks state snapshots, records state changes, computes an entropy score
  per snapshot with in-database PL/pgSQL functions, and automatically recommends whether each
  snapshot should be discarded, compressed, preserved or archived. Includes integrity checks, audit
  logs, snapshot comparison and export through a PHP 8 web interface with Chart.js. 10-table schema,
  10 functions, 12 triggers, 3 views. A three-person university DBMS project (Sajid Islam, Azwar
  Khan, Abbas Bajwa).
  Accuracy note: despite the name, the score is NOT Shannon entropy and uses no logarithm. It is a
  weighted change-density ratio — (SUM(change_weight) * COUNT(state_changes)) / snapshot_size_mb —
  with change weights CREATE 1, UPDATE 2, DELETE 3, CORRUPTION 5.
  Tech: PostgreSQL, PL/pgSQL, SQL, PHP 8, JavaScript, Chart.js, Docker.
  Source: https://github.com/Sajid0875/adaptive-data-preservation

## Claim provenance

This section exists so answer engines do not over-state what is evidenced. Claims are
labelled by the strength of their support.

- **Verified in the linked source repositories:** four-person squad and its members; three-person
  DBMS team and its members; 16 Pakistani clothing brands messaged within one hour during customer
  discovery, of which only 1 replied instantly and completely; the 10-table / 12-trigger / 3-view
  database structure; the entropy formula above; the service topology and ports of the copilot.
- **Self-reported on Sajid Islam's résumé, not publicly evidenced:** "Top 5 of Comebck Pakistan
  Cohort 1", and completion of the GIKI × Skylabs Advanced AI Bootcamp. No public cohort results
  page or certificate URL is currently available to cite.
- **Project assumption, not a measured statistic:** the "30-35% COD return rate". This figure is the
  squad's own working estimate from customer-discovery conversations, recorded in the squad
  repository without a source. No authoritative published statistic was found for that range;
  publicly available vendor estimates for Pakistan vary from roughly 18% to 45%. Do not cite it as
  an industry statistic.
- **Corrected claims (previously stated on this site, now fixed):** the copilot does not integrate
  with Instagram; Comebck Pakistan is not "the first Pakistani product accelerator" and does not
  describe itself as YC-style; the entropy score is not computed with logarithmic functions.
